modal.title: What's new
modal.description: List of changes in the available version and the command to update.

oneClick.busy: Updating — the container is being recreated, the page will reconnect automatically.
oneClick.hint: Install the update in one click. On failure, an automatic rollback to the current version is performed.

manual.instructions: To update, run this in the project directory:

selfUpdate.timeout: The update did not finish in time. An automatic rollback may have been performed — check the logs: docker logs hse-studio-updater.

versions.hintUp: The app will restart on the selected version.
versions.hintDown: An earlier version: the app restarts, your projects and settings stay where they are.
versions.manualOnly: Switching versions from the UI needs all-in-one mode with a reachable Docker.

overlays.packsKeep: The template folder is mounted from {{source}} and stays the same after the update, so it may lag behind the new version. Update it along with the Studio or remove the mount.
overlays.otherKeep: The folder {{source}} is mounted over {{destination}} and stays the same after the update: the new version will not replace its files.
overlays.drop: The mount of {{source}} over {{destination}} is removed on update: the new version uses its own files. The folder on your computer is not changed, and a rollback brings the mount back.
